method: R1 blind suread (subagent read text only, no md/rules)

facts.fact: Hattie 做了晚饭——鸡肉 fettuccine alfredo 配蒜香面包和蒸胡萝卜，并让 Tommy 帮忙削胡萝卜；她强忍住没在他落泪时去抱他。
facts.anchor: Chicken fettuccine alfredo with garlic bread and steamed carrots.

facts.fact: Hattie 打开从市场买来的酒想递给 Tommy 一杯，他拒绝了，说上次喝酒就是鼻子被打断的那晚。
facts.anchor: The last time I drank was the night I got this

facts.fact: Tommy 讲述自己的经历：逃脱六个月后他在 Iowa，从垃圾桶里找到半瓶廉价伏特加一口气喝掉大半。
facts.anchor: It was six months after I escaped. I was in Iowa.

facts.fact: Tommy 说两个警察在他偷来的帐篷旁发现他，其中一人打他，鼻子断裂、血顺着喉咙往下流，他呛咳到吐了出来。
facts.anchor: My nose snapped and blood went down the back of my throat

facts.fact: Tommy 说本想去加油站洗手间重新整理仪容，却在镜子里一瞬间认不出自己，并觉得这样很好。
facts.anchor: when I looked in the mirror I didn’t recognize myself for a second

facts.fact: 晚饭后 Hattie 问要不要去散步，Tommy 点头答应，穿上刚洗好的毛衣和她那天在镇上给他买的外套。
facts.anchor: he dips his head and pulls on his freshly washed sweater along with the coat she bought for him that day in town.

facts.fact: 两人在黑暗中走到岩石上眺望海湾时，Tommy 讲起他在 Montana 露营过的一个山湖：水清见底，月色极美却让他无比孤独。
facts.anchor: There was this mountain lake in Montana I camped near

facts.fact: Tommy 承认自己一度也以为是罪人、想不起 Cheryl 死那晚的事，还梦见体内藏着一个会在睡梦中作恶的secret man；Hattie 转身紧紧抱住儿子，轻声说出「I’m sorry」。
facts.anchor: Hattie turns and hugs her son. Holds him as tightly as she can.

facts.fact: 在一段难熬的沉默之后，Tommy 终于回抱了 Hattie——这是她说过最重要的两个字得到的回应。
facts.anchor: After a terrible interminable moment of nothing, he hugs her back.
